title: Cambridge IELTS 16 Test 3 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
scenario: The plans below show the site of an airport now and how it will look after redevelopment next year.

visualData.title: SOUTHWEST AIRPORT
notes: The current airport plan has eight gates, numbered 1 to 8, reached by a walkway.
The after-development plan has eighteen gates, numbered 1 to 18, arranged along a central concourse with two branches and served by a sky train.
The current departures area contains check-in, and the current arrivals area contains a café.
After development, the departures area contains check-in, bag drop and a café; shops are located beyond security and passport control.
After development, the arrivals area contains a café, ATM and car hire.
Security and passport control are shown in the departures side in both plans; passport control and customs are shown in the arrivals side in both plans.
